_meta.source: BIR — most commonly-referenced forms. Form numbers and titles are stable; status reflects EOPT (RA 11976, 2024) changes where applicable.

schema.name: Official form title
schema.status: active / superseded — set when EOPT or other regulation removed the form

notes: Not exhaustive — this v0.1 covers the most commonly referenced ~20 forms.
BIR Form 2550M (monthly VAT declaration) was removed by the EOPT Act (RA 11976, 2024); VAT filings are now quarterly only via 2550Q.
Form 0619-F was renumbered from 1602; both numbers may appear in older docs.
PRs welcome for additional forms — open one against this dataset.

forms.name: Monthly Remittance Form of Creditable Income Taxes Withheld (Expanded)
forms.purpose: Remit expanded withholding tax for the first two months of each quarter

forms.name: Monthly Remittance Form of Final Income Taxes Withheld
forms.purpose: Remit final withholding tax for the first two months of each quarter

forms.name: Monthly Remittance Return of Income Taxes Withheld on Compensation
forms.purpose: Employer's monthly remittance of withholding tax on employee compensation

forms.name: Quarterly Remittance Return of Creditable Income Taxes Withheld (Expanded)
forms.purpose: Employer's quarterly EWT return covering the prior quarter

forms.name: Quarterly Remittance Return of Final Income Taxes Withheld
forms.purpose: Quarterly remittance of final withholding tax (e.g. dividends, royalties, interest)

forms.name: Annual Information Return of Income Taxes Withheld on Compensation
forms.purpose: Year-end information return for employee withholding (paired with 2316 alphalist)

forms.name: Annual Information Return of Creditable Income Taxes Withheld (Expanded)
forms.purpose: Year-end information return for EWT (paired with 2307 alphalist)

forms.name: Annual Information Return of Income Payments Subjected to Final Withholding Taxes
forms.purpose: Year-end information return for final withholding tax

forms.name: Annual Income Tax Return for Individuals Earning Purely Compensation Income
forms.purpose: Annual ITR for employees with only employment income (one employer, no other income)

forms.name: Annual Income Tax Return for Self-Employed Individuals, Estates and Trusts
forms.purpose: Annual ITR for individuals with mixed income (employment + business/profession)

forms.name: Annual Income Tax Return for Individuals Earning Income Purely from Business/Profession
forms.purpose: Annual ITR for pure self-employed or professionals (no employment income)

forms.name: Quarterly Income Tax Return for Self-Employed Individuals, Estates and Trusts
forms.purpose: Quarterly ITR for self-employed individuals (Q1, Q2, Q3)

forms.name: Annual Income Tax Return for Corporations, Partnerships and Other Non-Individual Taxpayers Subject Only to Regular Income Tax Rate
forms.purpose: Annual ITR for corporations under the regular rate only (no special/preferential rates)

forms.name: Annual Income Tax Return for Corporations Exempt under § 30 of the Tax Code or under a Special Law
forms.purpose: Annual ITR for exempt corporations (NGOs, GOCCs, etc.)

forms.name: Annual Income Tax Return for Corporations with Mixed Income Subject to Multiple Income Tax Rates
forms.purpose: Annual ITR for corporations with both regular and special/preferential rates (PEZA, BOI, etc.)

forms.name: Quarterly Income Tax Return for Corporations, Partnerships and Other Non-Individual Taxpayers
forms.purpose: Quarterly ITR for corporations (Q1, Q2, Q3)

forms.name: Certificate of Update of Exemption and of Employer's and Employee's Information
forms.purpose: Update employer/employee info on change of status (marriage, birth, etc.)

forms.name: Certificate of Compensation Payment / Tax Withheld for Compensation Payment With or Without Tax Withheld
forms.purpose: Year-end certificate employer issues to each employee documenting compensation + WT

forms.name: Monthly Value-Added Tax Declaration
forms.purpose: Monthly VAT declaration (SUPERSEDED — see 2550Q)
forms.superseded_basis: RA 11976 (EOPT Act) — monthly VAT filing requirement removed

forms.name: Quarterly Value-Added Tax Return
forms.purpose: Quarterly VAT return (only required filing for VAT-registered taxpayers post-EOPT)

forms.name: Quarterly Percentage Tax Return
forms.purpose: Quarterly percentage tax return for non-VAT-registered taxpayers (≤₱3M gross)
